read.limit: Local trace evidence, not authenticated telemetry. Internal model use is unobservable. Partial/trimmed/inline reads are not inferred.

studies.interval_method: Bonferroni subtraction of two97.5% exact Clopper-Pearson marginal intervals; at least95% coverage for paired difference; no catalog-wide claim.
studies.limit: 1 planned paired case(s) on one CLI setup. One bounded public repository-repair pilot. Baseline and treatment executed; not the planned ten-case study or a broad efficacy estimate. No pooling with inline-reference studies, no ranking by p-values, no inference that installed means read or used.
